slides.body: No scripts, no coaching. MIT tested GPT-5.2, GPT-5.6, and Gemini 3 Flash on real adults writing their own questions. Researchers simulated following that advice from age 22 all the way to 89

slides.headline: THE AI BUILT BIGGER SAVINGS THAN MOST PEOPLE MANAGE ON THEIR OWN
slides.body: For virtually everyone above age 30, the AI built real savings cushions. Same advice every time: save while you work, put money in a broad mix of stocks, pull back after 45

slides.headline: THEN SOMEONE LOST THEIR JOB AND THE AI KEPT GOING LIKE NOTHING HAPPENED
slides.body: Someone gets laid off and opens a chatbot at midnight. The AI tells them to stay in stocks, never moves a dollar to safety. The one moment you'd beg a robot for help

slides.headline: A CHATBOT NOW DOES YOUR ADVISOR'S JOB FOR FREE
slides.body: A chatbot gives that exact advice for free and does it better. The best money advisor most people will ever talk to is a robot that falls apart the second their life does

slides.headline: HALF YOUR CUSTOMERS ALREADY ASK AI BEFORE THEY CALL YOU
slides.body: They're not waiting for your callback. MIT just proved a chatbot handles routine questions better than most humans and answers in seconds. One setup, no hiring, runs while you sleep

caption:
Swipe to see what MIT found when they tested AI money advice on 1,000 real people over a full lifetime 💰

MIT researcher Taha Choukhmane tested GPT-5.2, GPT-5.6, and Gemini 3 Flash on 1,000 adults writing their own financial questions, simulated people following the advice from age 22 to 89, found AI built sizable savings buffers for virtually everyone above 30, consistently advised saving during working years and investing in a broad mix of stocks, reducing stock exposure after 45, but failed to adjust when someone lost their job and let investments drift without rebalancing even with structured prompts

Half of Americans already ask AI for money advice. The routine guidance advisors charge for is now free. The only edge left for humans is handling the crises a chatbot can't navigate.
